thread:
nina: quick RFC follow-up on onboarding pipeline: proposing a minimal validator handshake so runners can be independent. main goals: avoid head-of-line blocking, clear golden fallback, and tiny telemetry.

omar: sounds good. state machine suggestion NEW -> SENT -> RETRY -> DEFERRED -> REVIEW. retry policy: exp+jitter, max_attempts=4, demote_after=2 within 60s.

priya: golden policy: no auto-rotation by default. allow manual/promote and emergency fallback to a 12-sample mini-golden. validator should return explicit codes: ok|missing|mismatch|corrupt.

bench-bot: note: historical silent mismatches on long sequences; include tokenizer_version and kv_cache_mb in telemetry.

nina: telemetry minimal set: request_id, model_sha, handshake_ver, state, attempts, elapsed_ms, golden_status, tokenizer_ver, seqlen_p95, kv_cache_mb. trace sample 1% general, 100% for ADMIT/CANARY.

omar: ops asks: add CLI: swap-golden, requeue-deferred <filter>. also add short diag_token (ttl 10m) to fetch extra traces when validator fails silently.

priya: agree. i'll write a short runbook for fallback usage. nina: can you land the compact schema?

nina: yup, i'll open a follow-up PR with schema v1 and example payloads today.

bench-bot: reminder: avoid bulk deferrals; recommend soft per-model rate limits rather than hard rejects.

nina: added to action items. thanks everyone.
